title: Fetch explicit remote refs during local distillation pull
goal: Make local-distill --pull resolve published snapshot and handoff refs from the configured origin without manual refspec fetches, while refusing arbitrary revisions and immutable-ref replacement.

results.change: local-distill --pull fetches validated refs/tags and refs/agents inputs when absent locally, verifies the advertised object, and refuses to overwrite a differing local ref; arbitrary revisions and non-main remote branches are not fetched.
results.focused: cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --bin local-distill: 33 passed, 0 failed; includes 2 new remote-ref regressions and the existing pull/reconciliation test
results.task_record_guard: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test task_records: 3 passed, 0 failed
results.clippy: cargo clippy --offline --locked -p xtask --bin local-distill --all-targets -- -D warnings: passed
results.native_gate: cargo local-workflow check completed all 114 binaries but was blocked by concurrent peer_channel_hub process/port contention; port_fallback 1/1, host_only_privacy 2/2 and peer_channel_hub 2/2 pass when run in isolation. No changed-path test failed.
results.boundary: Core distillation workflow only; no product, dependency, Commercial, Minijinja, release, or credential change
